description: This Java class 'AMControl' provides functionality to launch Android activities via shell commands using the ActivityManager (am) shell command. It includes methods for launching activities in the background and executing arbitrary shell commands, capturing their output.

classes.name: AMControl
classes.description: Provides methods to launch activities using the Android ActivityManager via shell commands.

methods.name: launchInBackground
methods.description: Launches a specified activity in the background using an Intent, constructing and executing the 'am start' shell command.

methods.name: execCmd
methods.description: Executes a specified shell command, returning its combined standard output and error streams as a string.
